Class CulturalEpochRegistryLoader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.CulturalEpochRegistryLoader
public final class CulturalEpochRegistryLoader extends Object
Discovers and parses ethnolinguistic cultural registries and entities across historical epochs from the cartographic tensor repository or procedural heuristics.
